paper.title: Large Language Monkeys : Scaling Inference Compute with Repeated Sampling

result.summary: 本文研究将推理阶段的计算量作为新的扩展维度，通过重复采样（repeated sampling）从语言模型生成大量候选解来提升推理性能 [S1.p3]。作者在 GSM8K、MATH、MiniF2F-MATH、CodeContests 和 SWE-bench Lite 五个任务上，用 Llama-3、Gemma、Pythia、DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 等模型生成最多 10,000 个样本，发现覆盖率随样本数增加而提升，且常可用指数幂律建模 [S1.p7][S3.p2]。在有自动验证器的编码和形式证明任务中，覆盖率提升直接转化为性能提升，例如 SWE-bench Lite 上 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 从单样本 15.9% 提升到 250 样本的 56%，超过单样本 SOTA 的 43% [S1.p8]。但在没有自动验证器的数学文字题中，多数投票和奖励模型等常见验证方法在约 100 个样本后趋于饱和，无法充分利用覆盖率提升 [S1.p10][S4.SS1.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在系统性地刻画重复采样作为推理阶段计算扩展手段的收益，即随着样本预算增加，模型覆盖率如何变化，以及能否从大量样本中识别出正确解 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。作者指出，尽管训练计算扩展已被广泛研究，但推理阶段的计算投入相对有限，用户和开发者通常只让模型对一个问题尝试一次 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Our goal is to systematically characterize these benefits across a range of tasks, models, and sample budgets.

1. Coverage: As the number of samples increases, what fraction of problems can we solve using any sample that was generated? 2. Precision: How often can we identify correct samples from our collection of generations?
However, when interacting with LLMs, users and developers often restrict models to making only one attempt when solving a problem.

method.text: 论文采用重复采样方法：对每个问题，用正温度从语言模型独立采样大量候选解，再用领域特定的验证器（如代码单元测试、Lean4 证明检查器）从样本中选出最终答案 [S1.F1]。作者用覆盖率（coverage，即至少一个生成样本能解决问题的题目比例）和精度（precision，即能否从样本集合中识别正确样本）两个指标来评估重复采样的效果 [S1.p5]。对于有自动验证器的任务，覆盖率提升直接对应成功率提升；对于 GSM8K 和 MATH，覆盖率对应使用 oracle 验证器检查是否有样本输出正确答案 [S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: 1) We generate many independent candidate solutions for a given problem by sampling from an LLM with a positive temperature. 2) We use a domain-specific verifier (ex. unit tests for code) to select a final answer from the generated samples.

1. Coverage: As the number of samples increases, what fraction of problems can we solve using any sample that was generated? 2. Precision: How often can we identify correct samples from our collection of generations?
For GSM8K and MATH, coverage corresponds to using an oracle verifier that checks if any sample “passes” by outputting the correct final answer.

experiments.text: 论文在五个任务上评估重复采样：GSM8K（128 个随机测试题）、MATH（128 个随机测试题）、MiniF2F-MATH（130 个 Lean4 形式化测试题）、CodeContests（140 个无图像标签的测试题）和 SWE-bench Lite（真实 GitHub 问题）[S2.p4]。主要实验用 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Llama-3-70B-Instruct 在 CodeContests、MiniF2F、GSM8K、MATH 上生成 10,000 个独立样本；SWE-bench Lite 使用 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 和 Moatless Tools 框架，每个问题限制 250 次独立尝试 [S2.SS1.p1]。此外还扩展到 Llama 3、Gemma、Pythia 等不同规模（70M-70B）和训练阶段的模型，在 MATH 和 CodeContests 上评估 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: 1. GSM8K: A dataset of grade-school level math word problems. We evaluate on a random subset of 128 problems from the GSM8K test set.
5. SWE-bench Lite: A dataset of real world Github issues, where each problem consists of a description and a snapshot of a code repository.
We evaluate Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-70B-Instruct on CodeContests, MiniF2F, GSM8K, and MATH, generating 10,000 independent samples per problem.
For SWE-bench Lite, we use DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct, as the required context length of this task exceeds the limits of the Llama-3 models.
• Llama 3: Llama-3-8B, Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Llama-3-70B-Instruct. • Gemma: Gemma-2B, Gemma-7B. • Pythia: Pythia-70M through Pythia-12B (eight models in total).
We restrict evaluation to the MATH and CodeContests datasets to minimize inference costs, reporting results in Figure 3.

findings.text: 覆盖率随样本数增加而提升，在多个任务和模型上跨越四个数量级，且覆盖率与样本数的关系常可用指数幂律建模 [S1.p7][S3.p2]。在有自动验证器的任务中，覆盖率提升直接转化为性能提升：SWE-bench Lite 上 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 从单样本 15.9% 提升到 250 样本的 56%，超过单样本 SOTA 的 43% [S1.p8]。重复采样还能让较弱模型以更低成本超越较强模型的单次尝试，例如在 SWE-bench Lite 上采样五次较便宜的 DeepSeek 模型比 Claude 或 GPT 单次尝试解决更多问题且成本低 3 倍以上 [S1.p9]。但在没有自动验证器的数学文字题中，多数投票和奖励模型在约 100 个样本后趋于饱和，无法达到覆盖率上界 [S1.p10][S4.SS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: Interestingly, the relationship between $\log(\text{coverage})$ and the number of samples often follows an approximate power law (Section 3).
1. The relationship between coverage and the number of samples can often be modelled with an exponentiated power law.
By simply increasing the number of samples to 250, we increase the fraction of solved issues to 56%, exceeding the state-of-the-art by 13%.

When keeping the agent framework (Moatless Tools) constant, sampling five times from the weaker and cheaper DeepSeek model solves more issues than single samples from Claude or GPT while also being over 3x cheaper.
When solving MATH problems with Llama-3-8B-Instruct, coverage increases from 82.9% with 100 samples to 98.44% with 10,000 samples.
While success rates initially increase with the number of samples for all three methods, they plateau around 100 samples.

limitations.text: 作者明确承认，实验只探索了最简单的重复采样形式，即所有尝试使用完全相同的提示和超参数独立生成，未探索解多样性、多轮交互和从先前尝试中学习等改进方向 [S5.p2][S5.p3]。此外，论文指出在没有自动验证工具的任务中，常见验证方法（多数投票和奖励模型）无法随样本预算扩展，需要改进样本验证方法 [S5.p5]。作者还提到，仅用 FLOPs 衡量成本可能过于粗糙，忽略了系统效率的其他方面 [S2.SS3.p4]。

evidence.quote: In our experiments, we explore only a simple version of repeated sampling where all attempts to a problem are generated independently of one another using the exact same prompt and hyperparameters.
1. Solution Diversity: We currently rely on a positive sampling temperature as the sole mechanism for creating diversity among samples.
Our results from Section 4 highlight the importance of improving sample verification methods when tools for automatically doing so are unavailable.
We note that examining FLOPs alone can be a crude cost metric that ignores other aspects of system efficiency.
